00-load-demo-store.ts.description: Shopify ops (project 9): loads the Kettle & Fern demo store (products, orders, abandoned checkouts, reviews) into the test tables.

01-store-api.ts.description: Shopify ops (project 9): store adapter. Reads checkouts, orders, inventory and reviews from the Shopify Admin API (live) or the Kettle tables (test).

02-abandoned-carts.ts.description: Shopify ops (project 9): every 30 minutes, a personal recovery email for each abandoned checkout, with an offer only when the rules allow one.

03-review-insights.ts.description: Shopify ops (project 9): Monday report of what customers praise and complain about, from new reviews tagged by AI, with three suggested fixes.

04-low-stock.ts.description: Shopify ops (project 9): daily low-stock alert from sales velocity, supplier lead times and a safety buffer, with reorder quantities. No AI.

05-order-help.ts.description: Shopify ops (project 9): the store's help chat. Answers 'where is my order?' after checking the order number and email, and opens a ticket for late parcels.

06-send-email.ts.description: Shopify ops (project 9): sends an email with Gmail in live mode or writes it to the Kettle Outbox table in test mode.

07-help-tools.ts.description: Shopify ops (project 9): tools for the help chat. Looks up an order (number and email must match) and opens a support ticket for late parcels.
